highlights.title: Bloom is now Bloomkeeper
highlights.detail: Same app, new name, ahead of the source going public: Bloomkeeper is an independent companion for Darkbloom. Your history, settings, optimizer plan and phone link carry over unchanged, and updates keep arriving as before. If you installed from the website, the app in your Applications folder may keep its old name until you reinstall; that's fine.

highlights.title: Pace in cents or dollars
highlights.detail: The Pulse meter now shows your pace in cents per hour (20.53¢) by default. Tap the number, or use the meter's settings, to switch to dollars ($0.21); Bloomkeeper remembers your choice.

highlights.title: Only Tailscale can reach the phone view
highlights.detail: Bloomkeeper's phone connection now answers only requests that come through Tailscale, so other programs and other accounts on your Mac can't reach it directly. If phone access is already on, Bloomkeeper updates its Tailscale setting by itself and your phone link stays the same.
